tools.name: lookup_customer_info
tools.description: Look up a customer by submitter email or customer_id. Returns customer_id, name, plan tier, and SSO status.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch the full ticket record (subject, body, submitter) by ticket_id.

tools.name: spawn_specialist
tools.description: Hand one category of issue to a specialist who has the tools to act on it. category is billing (refunds, charges), technical (API, webhooks), or account (SSO, 2FA, permissions). Call once per category with an issue. Returns the specialist's writeup: ACTIONS TAKEN, NOT DONE, OUT OF SCOPE.

tools.name: write_response
tools.description: Send the final customer reply. resolution_status: resolved only if every issue has a confirmed action; needs_info if waiting on the customer; escalated if any issue needs a human.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand an issue to a human when no specialist can handle it (for example authorizing a penetration test, or a refund that could not be verified). Put the full context in summary_for_human.
